name: Intermediate Decomposition Classes Form Strict pc-Closed Hierarchies
statement: The inclusions $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}\subsetneq\mathcal D_1\subsetneq\mathcal D_{\mathrm{amp}}\subsetneq\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}\subsetneq\mathcal B\subsetneq\mathcal D_{\mathrm{amp}}$ are strict. Every ample class of VC dimension at most two belongs to $\mathcal D_1$. Every fixed decomposition level and the both-sides dismantlable class $\mathcal B$ are closed under nonempty pc-minors, full reductions, and Cartesian products; $\mathcal B$ is complement closed after adjoining the empty boundary case.
proof: Recursive decomposition gives the inclusions, the VC-two theorem, and closure under minors, reductions, and products. The tangent-pentagon class lies in the first decomposition level and in $\mathcal B$ but is not recursively peripheral. Hall's class is ample and not dismantlable; its complement is dismantlable and belongs to $\mathcal B$ but an exhaustive one- and two-coordinate section test excludes level one. Complement-section identities exchange projection with full reduction and prove the closure assertions for $\mathcal B$.
